title: Expressing Opinions
summary: 表达观点、赞同反对、解释原因和条件句。
objectives: Support an opinion with reasons and examples
Compare choices and suggest a compromise

passages.transcript: Welcome to the town hall! Are you here for the group discussion? Please meet us in the Maple Room. The session lasts 45 minutes. It begins at 16 fifteen. I can show you where to go.
